title: Profile-prioritized mixed-precision kernel dispatcher and validation harness
creator: Asha Gupta
description: Implement a runtime kernel dispatcher that ranks available precision paths (FP16, FP8, INT8) using an offline-generated quantization profile score and live telemetry. The dispatcher must: 1) prioritize kernel paths per-request (and optionally per-layer) based on a profile score composed of accuracy delta, expected token latency, and cost-per-token; 2) offer a fast-path decision matrix for low-latency traces and a safe-path with additional online confidence checks for high-accuracy routes; 3) support hot-fallback to next-best compatible kernel when the chosen kernel misses SLOs or exhibits confidence drops; 4) integrate with the calibration pipeline to refresh profile scores after re-calibration or model changes; 5) emit structured tracing events and metrics for each decision for observability and later audit. This ticket covers runtime dispatch implementation and integration points for the validation harness (accuracy regression checks, golden prompt set, and per-route evaluation).
acceptance_criteria: Dispatcher picks kernel path deterministically given a quant-profile input and request attributes (latency budget, route, model_version)
Profile score format documented and persisted; calibration runs produce a profile file that the dispatcher consumes
Unit + integration tests covering fast-path, safe-path, and fallback behaviors with synthetic telemetry

End-to-end regression harness demonstrates <= 1% accuracy delta (top-1 token distribution) for FP8 vs FP16 on golden prompts for guarded routes, and latency/cost improvements measured for opportunistic routes
Tracing shows decision_reason and profile_id tags for 100% of routed requests in staging
design_notes: Profile score = weighted sum(accuracy_penalty, median_token_latency, relative_cost). Accuracy_penalty derived from calibration delta on a curated prompt set
Two decision modes: FAST (no online confidence checks) and GUARD (run confidence check thresholds after generation or per-block to possibly fall back)
Per-layer hybridization is out of scope for this ticket; we'll choose kernel per-tensor-blocking group in a follow-up if experiments show benefit
Profile files versioned with model_version and calibration_checksum. Dispatcher loads profile cache and invalidates on model/version change
Compatibility matrix captured in runtime: which kernels support KV-cache layout, which require rematerialization, and memory headroom needed for INT8/FP8 kernels
experiments: calibration-run-2026-02-05: FP8 profile (gptx-small) on webtext-val: accuracy_penalty=0.7%, median_latency_improvement=18%, cost_delta=-32%
calibration-run-2026-02-09: INT8 profile (gptx-small) on webtext-val: accuracy_penalty=1.9%, median_latency_improvement=25%, cost_delta=-48%
safety-check-2026-02-12: confidence-trigger threshold 0.82 reduces FP8 regressions by 60% at +6ms median latency
canary-staging-2026-02-18: routed 5% traffic (opportunistic) to profile-priority dispatcher; observed no P99 latency regressions; flagged three sessions for fallback due to mismatched kv-cache layout
decisions: Use profile-prioritization (score) instead of pure thresholding to allow tradeoffs between cost and accuracy per route
Implement fallback by kernel ABI compatibility: only fall back to kernels that share the same KV-cache layout to avoid expensive state rebuilds unless in GUARD mode
Keep per-layer kernel selection deferred to a follow-up ticket (complexity + minimal measured gains in early runs)
Expose 'profile_id' in tracing and the console so PM/SEs can audit which quant-profile served a request
tasks: Spec: define profile score schema and storage path (runtime/profiles/<model>/<version>/<profile_id>.json)
Runtime: implement dispatcher module with FAST and GUARD modes and profile cache loader
Runtime: implement compatibility matrix checks and fast ABI-based fallback
Calibration: add profile artifact emission to calibration pipeline (checksum, sample_stats, accuracy_deltas)
Testing: unit mocks + integration tests for decision matrix and fallback triggers
Validation: add golden prompt set run to regression harness and a dashboard card to track top-1/token-distribution deltas
Observability: add tracing fields (profile_id, decision_mode, decision_reason, fallback_reason) and metrics (chosen_profile_count, fallback_count, avg_profile_score)
Canary: deploy to staging with 5% traffic, collect two weeks of traces, run automated accuracy checks
blockers: Need final schema for profile file from calibration team (waiting on ENG-4217 follow-ups)
Memory estimation API for new FP8 kernels is pending (ENG-73456 related) - without it dispatcher can't ensure headroom
QA golden prompt set requires expansion to cover non-English canonical prompts (ops request)
CI flaky GPU test for INT8 kernels causing intermittent failures in integration runs
